title: Croatian Pilaf with a Twist
description: A variation of traditional Croatian pilaf, this recipe adds a nutty and energizing twist with the inclusion of rice and vinegar.
instructions: Heat the water in a medium saucepan over high heat.
Add the Croatian pilaf and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the rice, energizing, and nutty. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the vinegar.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Optional: add chopped almonds or nutritional yeast on top for garnish.
